resources.string: Manje ungasebenzisa isigxivizo somunwe ukuze uvule ifoni yakho noma uqinisekise ukuthi nguwe. Ukuze uthole ukuguquguquka okukhulu, engeza esinye isigxivizo somunwe.
Inzwa yesigxivizo somunwe izoba sesikrinini esilandelayo
Le khodi ye-QR akuyona eyesivikeli sesikrini esigunyaziwe
Une-%s.\nYisebenzise ngaphambi kokusetha Ukuvula Ngezigxivizo Zeminwe.
Beka ikhodi kumaphakheji okuvikela isikrini ohlakeni
Isivikeli sesikrini singaba nomphumela ekubonweni kwesigxivizo somunwe. Ukuze uthole ukusebenza okungcono kakhulu Kokuvula ngesigxivizo somunwe ngesivikeli sesikrini:

Uma kwenzeka, faka isivikelo sesikrini ngaphambi kokusetha Ukuvula Ngezigxivizo Zeminwe bese ucindezela wenze isicaba noma yimaphi amabhamuza akhona. Uma kudingeka ukusebenzise ngemva kokusetha, skena ikhodi ye-QR kamuva ngekhamera yakho.
Sebenzisa isivikeli sesikrini esenzelwe isitifiketi Sokwenzelwe iGoogle
Skena ikhodi ye-QR kuphakheji yesivikeli sesikrini

Isivikeli sesikrini esenzelwe ukuqinisekiswa iGoogle sinekhodi ye-QR ephakhejini. Ezinye izivikeli zesikrini zingase ziphazamise inzwa futhi ziyivimbe ingasebenzi ngokwethembeka.\n\nFunda kabanzi kokuthi g.co/pixel/screenprotector
Ukuze uthuthukise ukuqashelwa kwesigxivizo somunwe, susa isivikeli sakho sesikrini ngaphambi kokuvala ukulungiselelwa kwesivikeli sesikrini
Isivikeli sakho sesikrini singase singahambisani nefoni yakho. Ukuze uqinisekise, buyekeza ifoni yakho ibe nohlobo lwakamuva lwe-Android bese uyazama futhi.
Lesi senzo sikhawulelwe kumnikazi wedivayisi kuphela
